Subject: BrightHealth AI trial evaluation playbook & next steps

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed lightweight evaluation playbook so we can align on success criteria and the environment choice (hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC). I attached a one-page scope and a checklist for network questions.

TL;DR recommendation: start with a 2-week Dedicated sandbox for fastest, lowest-risk validation (predictable throughput, isolation) and run a parallel Hosted smoke-run for day-0 functional checks. VPC pilot can follow once security sign-off is complete (typically 4–6 weeks).

Proposed success criteria (draft) — please confirm or edit:
- Functional: model outputs match your 50 representative prompts (>= 90% pass on accuracy ruleset).
- Latency: P95 generation time < 650ms for 1k-token responses under typical load.
- Cost: < $25 per 1k tokens for production-like throughput (post-quantization guidance).
- Reliability: no sustained errors > 1% over 24h test window; graceful fallback to smaller model if saturated.
- Security: data residency in US region; audit logs available for review.

High-level evaluation plan (week-by-week):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope & sign off on network requirements (attachments).
- Week 1: Dedicated sandbox stand-up + Hosted smoke-run (small sample).
- Week 2: Full run of evaluation prompts, latency/cost tests, and basic failover tests.
- Week 3: Findings review and decision + next-step planning (VPC pilot if needed).

Owners:
- BrightHealth: Emma (product), Tom (cloud ops) — provide sample prompts, metrics, access window
- Redwood: Neha (AE) — project lead; Grace (Solutions Eng) — environment setup & benchmarking; Sergio — contract/discount approvals

Next steps I suggest:
1) You sign the attached trial_scope.xlsx and confirm the 50 sample prompts (or share a doc).
2) Tom shares IP ranges and KMS/HSM requirements if you want a VPC later (network_requirements.pdf attached).
3) We'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Grace to lock infra sizing (I can do Tues or Wed next week).

If this looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff and get the sandbox reserved.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Hi Emma —

Thanks — great, we’ll wait for the 50 prompts. To answer your questions quickly:

- Hosted vs Dedicated latency: Hosted uses our multi-tenant hosted API with dynamic routing; for small functional smoke tests it’s fastest to spin up (minutes) but latency and tail behavior vary with overall shared load. Dedicated sandbox gives pinned capacity/GPUs and consistent latency (predictable P95) — that’s why we recommend it for load and SLAs testing.

- Logs & retention: Redwood hosted tier supports 90-day audit log retention by default. For 180-day retention and stronger separations you’ll want Dedicated or Private (VPC) where we provide configurable retention and can integrate with your log archive (S3).

- Dedicated config templates: attached dedicated-sandbox-config.json (sample); Grace will review and propose a minimal configuration (we typically start 4x A10G equivalent for a 2-week sandbox — we can scale up/down).

One additional suggestion for the evaluation: include a small, time-boxed chaos test — ramp concurrency to 2x expected peak for 10 minutes and validate graceful fallback (no silent failures, clear error codes). Helps validate the routing/fallback policies.

If that aligns, I’ll provision a Dedicated sandbox tentatively for the window below and Grace will send a sizing calendar invite.

Proposed sandbox window: 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-20 (2 weeks)
Kickoff: 30-min with Grace on 2026-07-07 10:00 AM PT
Decision meeting: 2026-07-21 11:00 AM PT

Best,
Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
